title: A Call For Xbox To End Cycle Of Layoffs Is Trending On Fan Portal - Kotaku
title_zh: Xbox 玩家呼籲「停止裁員循環」在官方意見平台發燒
summary: Fans are fed up with constant mass layoffs at Xbox. A call to 'end studio closures' was posted on Microsoft's Player Voice Portal and has started trending with over 3,000 upvotes.
summary_zh: Xbox 玩家在微軟官方 Player Voice Portal 發起「終止工作室關閉」連署，獲得超過 3,000 讚登上熱門。這是玩家對 Xbox 自 2023 年以來第五波大規模裁員的直接反彈，反映出社群對遊戲工作室接連關閉的強烈不滿。

title: 'The entire thing is going to fall apart:' Inside the latest round of mass layoffs at Xbox - Game Developer
title_zh: 「整件事就要崩潰了」— Xbox 最新大規模裁員內幕
summary: Multiple sources across Bethesda, ZeniMax Online Studios, and id Software were laid off in Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's latest restructuring. 'Good work is not going to save your job at this company' was the sentiment.
summary_zh: Game Developer 深入報導微軟自 2023 年以來的第五波 Xbox 大規模裁員。受訪員工匿名透露，橫跨 Bethesda、ZeniMax Online Studios 和 id Software 的團隊在短短幾分鐘內被通知解雇。數百年的遊戲開發經驗瞬間化為烏有，離職員工痛批：「在這家公司，做好工作也保不住飯碗。」

title: Another Elder Scrolls game is in jeopardy as Xbox layoffs hit heads of major studio - Polygon.com
title_zh: Xbox 裁員打擊 Zenimax 高層，《上古卷軸》新作前途未卜
summary: More than 200 jobs cut at ZeniMax Online Studios. Senior figures have been let go, putting the future of The Elder Scrolls Online in turbulence.
summary_zh: Xbox 宣布本財年將裁員 3,200 人，其中 ZeniMax Online Studios 超過 200 個職位被砍，多位高層主管離職。《上古卷軸 Online》團隊受到嚴重衝擊，遊戲的未來更新與開發計畫充滿不確定性。

title: 2 months after releasing Zero Parades, Studio ZA/UM is laying off employees - PC Gamer
title_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 發售新作兩個月後宣布裁員
summary: ZA/UM cites commercial performance of Zero Parades as reason for laying off 32 employees. The game struggled to stand on its own feet despite the legacy of Disco Elysium.
summary_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 在推出新作《Zero Parades》僅兩個月後宣布裁員 32 人。官方表示商業表現不足以維持目前團隊規模。這款背負著 Disco Elysium 光環的作品雖獲好評，但銷售未能達標，引發產業對獨立工作室永續經營的討論。

title: id Software insists in new statement that it still has 'the crew we need' - Eurogamer.net
title_zh: id Software 發聲明安撫：我們還有能力做出好遊戲
summary: id Software posted a statement on social media thanking players for support and insisting they still have the crew needed to build great games. The team today is about the same size as when making Doom 2016.
summary_zh: 在 Microsoft/Xbox 大規模裁員後，id Software 於社群媒體發表聲明，感謝玩家支持並強調「我們仍然擁有打造遊戲所需的團隊」。目前團隊規模與《毀滅戰士 2016》時期相當，試圖安撫粉絲對《毀滅戰士》系列未來的擔憂。

title: In An Era Of AI Slop, Meccha Chameleon Embraces Human-Crafted Chaos - GameSpot
title_zh: 在 AI 垃圾內容橫行的時代，《Meccha Chameleon》選擇擁抱手工混亂
summary: The game Meccha Chameleon embraces human-crafted chaos in an era of AI slop. Creators argue that AI-generated placeholders deny audiences something genuine and rob artists of the discovery that comes from struggling through iterations.
summary_zh: GameSpot 專題探討在 AI 生成內容充斥遊戲產業的當下，《Meccha Chameleon》這款遊戲選擇回歸手工創作。文章批評 AI 生成素材讓創作者失去了反覆迭代中的發現驚喜，也讓玩家無法體驗到真正真誠的作品，呼籲產業重新重視人類藝術家的價值。
